thread:
owen: Heads-up: I sketched a narrower GA gating proposal focused on operational friction customers keep calling out. Key items: operator UI for tenant routing, preflight CIDR-conflict checks, and a staged per-tenant canary for network upgrades. Pushing doc to drive.
mira: Nice. Field asks also include split-horizon DNS support for on-prem where internal names differ. That affects our DNS relay design. Could be a blocker for a finance customer.
vikram: On the routing UI: we can add a small toggle to the operator console to pin routing-mode per-tenant (relay / direct-bgp). Low-risk change and helps operators during upgrades.
sara: QA: we need explicit MTU and path-mtu test vectors in staging. Customers saw flaky streaming with overlay when MTU < 1400. Add e2e test for 1350/1500.
elaine: Solutions: for CIDR overlap cases we should document two migration patterns: 1) IP-preserve (NAT mapping) and 2) tenant-swap (drain + reattach). Both must be in playbook with expected downtime numbers.
vikram: automation note: preflight should reject installs where tenant CIDR conflicts with host pod CIDR unless operator passes an accept-risk flag. That reduces surprises.
deploy-bot: nightly-smoke (private-installer) completed 1781230950  logs/priv-installer/1781230950
owen: proposal for GA gating (short): A) Operator routing UI + presets.yaml with validation B) Preflight CIDR-check + explicit accept-risk override C) MTU test coverage in CI and staging D) Documented migration playbook with two patterns and must-gather artifacts E) Per-tenant canary rollout mechanism present (opt-in). KMS/HSM still post-GA.
mira: +1. Also add a short troubleshooting checklist for split-horizon DNS and record it in the runbook.
sara: Will add the MTU tests; need help creating network topologies in staging. vikram can we provision two small netns sandboxes?
vikram: Yep, will add netns harness and a sample presets.yaml with nat-relay and bgp-direct examples. PR by Tue.
elaine: I'll draft migration playbook with exact operator steps and expected timings for both patterns. ETA Wed.
owen: ok. action items: vikram -> presets + preflight PR; sara -> MTU test matrix; elaine -> migration playbook; mira -> DNS troubleshooting checklist; owen -> update roadmap doc and tag PM execs. If no objections I'll lock this for Friday GA gating review.
mira: no objections from me.
sara: no objections.
vikram: no objections.

owen: thanks all. Marking owners in the doc. :white_check_mark:
